parameters.name: Ultimate Tensile Strength
parameters.description: Maximum stress material can withstand before necking.

parameters.name: Fatigue Strength Coefficient
parameters.description: Intercept of Basquin log-log S-N curve at 1 cycle (reversal).

parameters.name: Fatigue Strength Exponent
parameters.description: Slope of the Basquin S-N curve. Typically ranges from -0.05 to -0.15.

parameters.name: Fatigue Endurance Limit
parameters.description: Stress amplitude below which damage accumulation is assumed to be zero.
